precepts.text: If a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual restore such an one in the spirit of meekness. You got to build and restore this man back to life, speak life into that brother to get him back on track. Bear ye one another's burdens; if we was in that same situation, we would want our brothers to come and get us out of it.
precepts.point: His three friends came every one from his own place to mourn with him and to comfort him, and sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him, for they saw that his grief was very great. Now you see the type of men that you're around; that is true friendship.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

precepts.why:
Job's three friends heard of all the evil that came upon him, came every one from his own place “to mourn with him and to comfort him”, and “sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.” Now you see the type of men you are around. That is true friendship, and Galatians shows what it is supposed to do.

“Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.” When a brother falls, you have to build and restore this man back to life. Speak life into that brother to get him back on track, in meekness, remembering you could be tempted too.

“Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.” If we were in that same situation, we would want our brothers to come and get us out of it.

Job held fast his integrity when he lost his kids, lost everything he had, and had boils all over his body. Satan came in through his wife, “curse God, and die”, but Job answered, “shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” A man going through that needs brothers who will sit with him, carry his burden with him and restore him, not tear him down.

precepts.text: Satan smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown: what Isaiah says of the nation is what Job went through, and Job was blessed at the end.
precepts.point: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity, Miss Laura included, and all that prey upon thee shall be a prey. For I will restore health unto thee: only the Lord heals, by Christ's stripes, for they that are whole need no physician and he came to call sinners to repentance. Because they call thee an outcast, African-American, Haitian, Jamaican, this is Zion whom no man seeketh after.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
What Isaiah and Jeremiah say of the nation is the same thing Job went through. People read Job and think that was only him, but Job's real life symbolizes the nation of Israel. This was the fifth judgment on Job: “So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.” Didn't we just read that in Isaiah 1? “From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it”.

Job's life is Deuteronomy 28. He lost his businesses, his family, everything. And “There is none to plead thy cause”: Job had friends who would not stand up on his behalf. They were always telling him he was wrong, evil, the devil. There was no cure; God had to intervene and heal Job. That is why the Lord sent Christ to heal the twelve tribes of Israel.

Even Job's wife turned on him in his darkest moment, when he had lost everything. That is how these black women do with us: in this state, the black woman turned on us.

But at the end of Job's life he was blessed. That is what is going to happen to us if we endure to the end: the incurable wound of Jeremiah 30 ends with “I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds”.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why: The one about sickness: “Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee. Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the Lord bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.” Very similar to what Job went through, we as a people are going through.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
“I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me”: that’s what the Lord is saying to our people. “The ox knoweth his owner”: as dumb as an ox is, he knows who his owner is. “And the ass his master’s crib”: as dumb as an ass is, you could put an ass a mile away and he could find his way home to his master’s crib. “But Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider”: we don’t know who our creator is, we don’t know our homeland and we don’t know our identity. That’s what that’s saying.

“Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.” “Ye will revolt more and more”.

Watch this: “the whole head is sick”, the whole head of the nation of Israel is sick, “and the whole heart faint.” “From the sole of the foot even unto the head”, from the sole of the foot of the Twelve Tribes of Israel even unto the head, “there is no soundness in it”. Just like there was no soundness in the forefather Job, there’s no soundness in the 12 tribes of Israel: “but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores”, just like Job had. “They have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.”

“Your country is desolate”: our homeland is desolate. “Your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.”

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why: “Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him”: Job’s mindset was though God slay him, yet will I trust in him. “But I will maintain mine own ways before him.” Job maintained his ways; he kept his integrity. That’s what you need to understand.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
“Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.” This is Christ saying this through the prophet. You might ask, why can’t I tell my wife everything? Biblically, there are certain situations to hold all that. Keep your mouth shut; you ain’t got to tell her everything. Samson had a simp spirit on him and it cost him dearly. Now, not all women are wicked, that’s not what’s being said, but Christ said don’t tell her everything.

You get into a marriage, telling your wife you got this set up, you got that set up, and she’s like, oh yeah, really, and she’s just biding her time. Not all women, not all. She waits for the opportune time and says I’ve been thinking about this, I want a divorce, and half of all the things you got I’m going to take. How does she know you got those things, brothers? Because you had to be a big mouth, a blabbermouth, and you told her everything. There have been several instances here in IUIC: brothers so hot you had to go get married, and she took you to the cleaners. She made sure what you got: a good job, what else you got. Your head is on her knees, she waited some time, took you to court, and now you are struggling working in McDonald’s. Learn from these classes; everybody in here is not Sarah. Here I am in the hospital all jacked up and my wife is asking what you got laid to the side for me? Don’t worry about it. When I’m dead you’ll know, not before. I ain’t telling you nothing.

“For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother”: y’all are seeing this today. “A man’s enemies are the men of his own house”: that’s what Christ said, what the Son of God said. “Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.” The only one we can trust in, brothers, is the Most High.

“Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise”. Believe it or not, some of your wives are waiting for you to drop dead and die. Not all, but some. We’ve seen it here: as soon as the brother died, she had a Christian funeral, praise white Jesus. You can’t make this stuff up. “When I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me. I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.”

Watch this: “Then she that is mine enemy shall see it”. She been waiting for you to drop dead and die. “And shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God?” This is what Job’s wife said, which is what some of your wives say: where’s the Lord your God? Brothers, don’t worry; some of y’all are going through it because you got Job’s wife. “Mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.” She gonna get what she deserves: trodden down like mud in the street. Dead, because she don’t believe in God, she don’t believe in this truth.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
The proof that it is Christ: “Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify”, the spirit of Christ which was in the prophets, “when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.”

So when we’re teaching and you hear us say Christ said this, Christ said that, and we’re in the book of Micah or the Book of Job, that is Christ speaking through them.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
Keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom: this is Samson and Delilah. “And she made him sleep upon her knees”: she put Samson to sleep upon her knees, “and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.” Delilah sexed Samson so good she made him fall asleep on her knees, and because he told her everything, she used it against him to destroy him.

Read above it: “When she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death; That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother’s womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me”.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
Let’s see if things changed in the New Testament. Some of you think you got a good wife; some of the sisters are legitimately good, but there are some. This week there was a video of a brother and wife here fist fighting in the house: she grabbed the baby, he’s trying to snatch the baby, she called the cops, she gets him arrested, he in jail. You can’t make this stuff up.

“For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.” Christ ain’t coming for peace in the house. Why? Because some are going to believe and some are not; that’s what it means. “And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.” Didn’t we just read that in Micah 7? Christ was speaking that through Micah; now he’s saying it for himself.

“He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me”. Some of you love your parents more than the Lord. Sisters have come and said I married a mama’s boy. Sister, you knew he was a mama’s boy before you got with him: he spoke to his mama every damn day, your argument with him his mama know about it, she call you and cuss you out. He’s not the type to marry. Brother, you know she love her mama and daddy more than you; she set it up so y’all get a place living near her parents, and they’re right there in all your business. You’re not worthy of the Lord God.

“And he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me”. Some of you sisters idolize your children; you love them kids more than Christ, you’re not worthy of him, you can’t be Christ’s disciple. If you love your kids, let them rebel against this truth and they will get you locked up. We have seen it from New York to Texas: my parents abused me, they forced me to keep God’s commandments and I don’t want to keep it. Click click, now you in jail. Y’all keep playing with them kids. They’re cute right now, some of y’all got adorable kids, but just wait till they get a little older and you’ll see if they for the Lord or for this world. Sometimes it depends on what mama is teaching them; sometimes they just pure demons.

“And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.” That means you have to be willing to risk your life, to give your life, to sacrifice your life for this truth. Some of you will, some of you won’t.

“He that findeth his life shall lose it”: when persecution comes you step back, you don’t want no parts of it, you want to save your life. Christ said you’re going to lose it: you’re going to get thermonuclear fire, the Lake of Fire. “And he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it”: that goes back to the cross in verse 38. If you give up your life for this truth, you’re gonna have eternal life. That’s what the Son of God says.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

precepts.why:
The Book of Job never says what Job did with his wife, whether he kept her and put her in check and she followed, or he got rid of her. The Lord left it open, because everybody’s situation may be a little bit different. Some women you can correct: sis, you sound stupid, don’t say that no more, and she says okay, I’m sorry, my lord. Some of y’all got wives that say drop dead, curse God and die, when you sick and can’t do nothing.

“And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets”: Christ speaking through Solomon finds more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, like Delilah. “And her hands as bands”: trying to trap you up from God, trying to keep you from the word of God. “Whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”: brother, if you want to please God, you’ll leave a woman like that. Escape means get the hell away.

“But the sinner shall be taken by her”: the simp. Oh, she’s the love of my life; I know she hate God and hate me, I know she smacked me upside the head, I know she called me a no-good dirty ass at times, but I love her, that’s my baby. God says the sinner shall be taken by her. The simple brother will never work up the courage to move the hell on and get the hell away from her; he’ll always have an excuse, a reason, I’m gonna do this, I’m gonna fix that. She ain’t changing. And it don’t matter how much muscles you got: the biggest and strongest brothers are the weakest of you all, big on the outside but real petite on the inside. A seven foot simp.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

Now you see the type of men that you're around; that is true friendship.

note.label: Character & Integrity: The Hidden Strength Behind Wisdom

points: Job still held fast his integrity, and Satan is called the one who moved the Lord against him without cause. That is the accuser at work, as Revelation 12 names him.
The deacon promises at least five classes on how to fight Satan, with the last on another level, and a separate class on the different ways Satan attacked Job.

note.label: Fighting Satan - the War Within

points: Skin for skin: touch his bone and his flesh. His bone and flesh includes his wife, bone of his bone. Satan was about to touch Job's wife too.

note.label: Fighting Satan - the War Within

points: 'He is in thine hand, but save his life.' You can get sick and every kind of thing can happen to you; that is Satan, but God allowed it and set the limit.

note.label: Fighting Satan - the War Within

points: 'Curse God, and die' was Satan speaking through Job's wife. She had lost everything and was worn down, and Satan entered her. Sisters, do not let Satan get in your head and use you to oppress your husband.

note.label: Fighting Satan - the War Within

points: We have to allow God to brag on us. It is the same thing with all our enemies watching online; you have got to give the Lord a chance to brag.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also. The Lord said, hast thou considered My servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst Me against him to destroy him without cause.
The Lord is bragging, He is boasting: even though you made Me go after Job for no reason at all, he is still standing strong, he is still handling his business.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Satan said, skin for skin, all that a man hath will he give for his life, but put forth thine hand now and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

Possessions are possessions; a brother could lose a car, a job, family members, whatever. But Satan is saying if his health is afflicted, I bet you he will curse you to your face, because that is another thing that gets us.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: The Lord said, behold, he is in thine hand, but save his life. The Lord said touch him but do not kill him. That does not sound like somebody rebellious against God; Satan took orders, just like we take orders.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Satan went forth and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown, and Job took a potsherd to scrape himself withal, and he sat down among the ashes.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Then his wife said, dost thou still retain thine integrity? Curse God, and die. This is the other test that brothers get.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Job said, thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh; what, shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

So he told her, woman, you sound foolish. Are we only going to get good from God and not evil? That is what we tell people all the time. We just read in Isaiah 45:7 that God creates evil and creates peace. God is a man of war; He creates life and death. Nothing happens without the Lord; everything asks for permission.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: Job's three friends heard of all this evil that came upon him: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. They made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

Much like us, our friends hear of our affliction and come to lend their support, to give correction, to give harsh reality and hard truth. We are not talking about people that butter you up knowing you are in the wrong; we are talking about people that give you straight facts about what is going on with you.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: When they lifted up their eyes afar off and knew him not, they lifted up their voice and wept, rent every man his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven. They sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word, for they saw that his grief was very great.

note.label: Job 2: Skin for Skin

points: “Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.”

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: “So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.” It’s very similar: what Job went through, we as a people are going through.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: Job lost everything, right? But look what Satan left him with: his wife. She didn’t get killed with the kids. “Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.” You can’t make this stuff up. Curse God and die: look at you, you’re sick, you’re on your last legs, die. Let it go.
Now back to his wife: his wife is our wife.

note.label: Job The Black Prophet And Our People Today

points: Although he was sick and jacked up, Job ain’t take no mess from her. “But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh”: woman, you sound stupid as hell. “Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” You was with me when God blessed us with homes, houses, source of income, you was good; but now that I lost everything, including my health? “In all this did not Job sin with his lips.”
